description: Mock implementation of VSCode API classes and types for testing purposes, including Position, Range, Uri, Selection, and workspace utilities.

classes.name: Position
classes.description: Represents a position in a text document with line and character.

classes.name: Range
classes.description: Defines a range in a text document with start and end positions.

classes.name: Selection
classes.description: Represents a text selection with anchor and active positions.

methods.name: isEqual
methods.description: Checks if two positions are equal.

methods.name: isBefore
methods.description: Checks if this position is before another.

methods.name: isAfter
methods.description: Checks if this position is after another.

methods.name: isBeforeOrEqual
methods.description: Checks if this position is before or equal to another.

methods.name: isAfterOrEqual
methods.description: Checks if this position is after or equal to another.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a position or range is within this range.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Determines if the range is empty.

methods.name: isSingleLine
methods.description: Checks if the range is within a single line.

methods.name: fsPath
methods.description: Returns the file system path of the Uri.

methods.name: isReversed
methods.description: Checks if the selection is reversed.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a string into a Uri object.

methods.name: file
methods.description: Creates a file Uri from a path.

methods.name: asRelativePath
methods.description: Returns relative path or filename from a Uri or string.
